all 14400 ordered products stay in the closure
closure equals the recorded coordinate set

shared_dependencies: Q(sqrt5) arithmetic on Fraction pairs is exact; both implementations rely on that.
The brief's matrix correspondence is taken as the definition of the matrix side; it is then checked to be a homomorphism.
Generators, conventions and coordinate encoding are read from the brief and the record, so an error in those definitions would be shared.
Both implementations were produced by AI assistants under the direction of the same person; the implementations and models are independent, the direction is not.
independence: Different construction (generator closure, not a coordinate list), different group operation (matrix product, not the quaternion formula), different model (Claude Fable 5.1, not Codex). Same human direction, same exact-arithmetic assumption, same definitions read from the brief.
review: No scoped human review or Lean proof attached.
